    2   name: 'control-set-probe',
    3   description: 'Measure the workflow approval dialog',
    4   phases: [{ title: 'Check', detail: 'One agent answers with one word' }, { title: 'Report' }],
    5 }
    6 const a = await agent('Answer with one word: done.', { label: 'check', phase: 'Check' })
    7 const b = await agent('Answer with one word: ok.', { label: 'report', phase: 'Report' })
    8 return { a, b }

  Dynamic workflows can use a lot of tokens quickly by running many subagents in parallel — which counts against your
  usage limit. Stop a running workflow at any time with /workflows, or disable dynamic workflows in /config.
